svg.text: 1. All signals are 3.3 V CMOS; no level shifting anywhere.
2. UART0 115200 8N1 to the cube's USART1. Cube TXD → GP1, cube RXD ← GP0 (crossed). The 4th wire of the
serial cable puts the cube's +5 V on GP2 (pin 4). RP2040 GPIOs are not 5 V tolerant: cut this wire or
leave the cable position empty. GP2 is never configured by the firmware.
3. Power: cube base board 5 V → VSYS (39), GND → pin 38. If USB is plugged in at the same time, put a
Schottky diode in the 5 V lead so the two supplies cannot fight (Pico W datasheet, powering section).
4. SPI1 to the ILI9341: 40 MHz, mode 2 (CPOL 1, CPHA 0), DMA ch 1 with chaining off. SDO → GP12 is never
read; FM (RDX) → GP9 is wired but not driven. GP14 / GP15 drive VCC / BL high at start-up.
5. XPT2046 uses software SPI on GP16–GP20; TPEN is low while touched; its GND returns on pin 23.
6. J1 and J3 are the two JST 1.25 mm connectors of one LCD module; J2 and J4 share the cube's ground.
Legend: a hop marks wires that cross without being connected.
